description: A LINE operand of NEXT PAGE alone, with no integer (kb/Work PB5242). §1985:XIII.3.15.2 prints `LINE NUMBER IS {integer-1 [ON NEXT PAGE] | PLUS integer-2}`, so a 1985 line is established by an integer (§1985:XIII.3.15.4 GR1: "A LINE NUMBER clause must be specified to establish each print line of a report group"); ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.33.1 Format 1 adds the third alternative `ON NEXT PAGE`. Gated by recognition, VersionConformancePass ParseArm.VisitReportLineOperand, once per written operand (VCR row 7.45 (f)).
display: a LINE operand of NEXT PAGE with no integer (report group description)
vcr: VCR row 7.45 (f) - LINE NEXT PAGE with no integer (85->2002)
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. VMRLN.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT PRT ASSIGN TO "VMRLN.TXT".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD PRT REPORT IS R1.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 WN PIC 9(3) VALUE 5.
REPORT SECTION.
RD R1 PAGE LIMIT IS 20 LINES.
01 DA TYPE DETAIL LINE NEXT PAGE.
    02 COLUMN 1 PIC X(3) VALUE "ABC".
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN OUTPUT PRT.
    INITIATE R1.
    GENERATE DA.
    TERMINATE R1.
    CLOSE PRT.
    STOP RUN.
